tagline: A workshop of small, useful tools
heroDescription: Free browser-based tools for PDFs, images, and everyday text work — no installs, no sign-ups, no nonsense.
founderNote: Built and maintained by one person in Pune, India, on a strict no-budget policy. If a tool saves you a step, that's the whole point.
footerNote: New tools ship regularly. Suggestions welcome by email.
